name: Heave plates, strakes and vortex-induced-motion suppression
description: Appendages on floating hulls: helical strakes reduce vortex-induced motion on columns, while heave plates add added mass and damping to pontoons or a spar. Their sizing is a motion-performance decision, not a strength one.

gaps.what: Strake pitch/height, heave-plate added-mass coefficient and VIM suppression
gaps.why: No page read gives strake geometry or a measured added-mass coefficient.
